setup: You are given $\cos 2t = [[cos_num]]/[[cos_den]]$ and asked for $\sin^{2} t$.

steps.say: The double-angle formula reads $\cos 2t = 1 - 2\sin^{2} t$, so the square of the sine is half of one minus the given cosine.
Subtracting $[[cos_num]]/[[cos_den]]$ from one leaves a fraction over [[cos_den]], and halving it gives [[answer]].
